title: Not every amendment needs the states, but some do
sources: M. Laxmikanth, Indian Polity, ch. 'Amendment of the Constitution'

quiz.q: A constitutional amendment bill on which the two Houses disagree:
quiz.why: Right. Article 368 has no joint-sitting provision, so the bill fails.

lines.say: Changing the Constitution isn't one procedure.
It's three, and the hardest one needs the states to agree.

beats.say: Changing the Constitution isn't one procedure. It's three, and the hardest one needs the states to agree.

lines.say: Some provisions change by a simple majority, and don't count as amendments under Article 368.
Most need a special majority in each House. Federal provisions also need half the state legislatures.

items.sub: Outside Article 368: new states, Rajya Sabha rules on quorum…
Two-thirds present and voting, and a majority of total membership

beats.say: Some provisions change by a simple majority, and don't count as amendments under Article 368. Most need a special majority in each House. Federal provisions also need half the state legislatures.

lines.say: The election of the President needs the states.
So do the Seventh Schedule's lists, and the states' representation in Parliament.
